## Description
A clear and concise description of what this pull request changes and why.

## Related issue
Closes #(issue number), if applicable.

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Content update (copy, services, process, contact details, images)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactor / cleanup

## How has this been tested?
Describe which pages you checked (home, services, process, about, contact, navigation, mobile menu, floating call and WhatsApp buttons, responsive layout) and whether you tested with reduced motion.

## Checklist
- [ ] This pull request targets `dev` (or is a `dev` to `main` release)
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` completes and the CI verify step passes
- [ ] Asset URLs use `asset()` and brand strings come from `BRAND`; no path prefix is hardcoded
- [ ] Deep links (for example `/services`) still load
- [ ] No console errors in the browser
- [ ] I have updated documentation where needed
